item.title: Nivlet 2.0.0 · Build 57
item.description: Nivlet 2.0.0: A unified sidebar for eight settings pages; local HTML/HTM forwarding; Save All Settings with stable footer feedback; Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), Japanese and native menu resources. Clipboard recording uses one enable switch in its own card instead of pause/resume, with existing history and retention preserved. The menu-shortcut switch displays ⌘⇧ + V without changing the actual binding; legacy custom bindings remain until that switch is changed and saved. Three clipboard explanations are removed. Click a thumbnail, or focus it and press Enter or Space, to open an image preview without a separate preview button. Previews close outside the image or with Escape; focus restoration after asynchronous history refresh is fixed. Includes targeted stability fixes and removal of development-only framework files. Removes 295 ordinary first-party code comments while retaining legal notices and functional tool markers; code semantics are unchanged. Local file support is limited to HTML/HTM; existing HTTP/HTTPS routing remains, without arbitrary scheme forwarding. Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 13+ only. Version 1.0.8 Build 55 is the final Intel release; historical downloads remain available. 八页侧边栏；本地 HTML/HTM 转交；跨页保存及稳定的底部反馈；繁体中文（台湾用语）、日语与原生菜单资源。剪贴板以独立卡片中的单一启用开关替代暂停/恢复，保留已有历史和保留期限；菜单快捷键显示为 ⌘⇧ + V，实际绑定不变，旧自定义绑定在实际切换开关并保存前保留。精简三处剪贴板说明。点击缩略图，或聚焦后按 Enter / Space 打开图片预览，不再显示独立预览按钮；点击图片外部或按 Esc 关闭，并修复异步历史刷新后的焦点恢复。另含针对性稳定性修复及框架开发文件精简。清理 295 条自有普通代码注释，保留法律声明与影响工具行为的标记，代码语义不变。本地文件仅新增 HTML/HTM，保留 HTTP/HTTPS 分流，不开放任意协议。仅支持 Apple Silicon（arm64）与 macOS 13+；1.0.8 Build 55 为最后 Intel 版，历史下载保留。迁移细节与协议边界见完整版本说明。
